---
description: Propose a Jira issue update after implementation or a PR.
---

# Update Ticket

Ask for the full issue key if missing. Apply `update-ticket`, `jira-context`, and
`jira-sdlc`: verify the issue on https://equisoft.atlassian.net/, the actual PR URL,
work summary, Acceptance Criteria/approval evidence if relevant, editable fields,
and available transitions with required fields. Show every exact
field/comment/transition payload and confirm it individually before writing.
Preserve rich text and full current multi-value fields. Read back after each write;
report partial or uncertain outcomes. A comment or plan approval never authorizes
a separate edit or status change.
